notes.title: Mint Plush Makeship Campaign!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41980347/3d6e5984954e0c087564cd76428ff7d3a9587964.jpg[/img]
“I’m not the best at this, but thanks in advance for taking care of me, Master!”

Mint, the cheerful Cherubim wants you to welcome her in to your home and now is the chance to do just that. We are once again collaborating with Makeship to turn Mint into an adorable plush that everyone can welcome home. The Makeship Petition campaign will run from April 8, 2025 to April 18, 2025 and if it reaches 200 pledges then the campaign will be converted into a regular Makeship product campaign. Spread the word and help us turn this plush concept into reality!

Mint is the mascot of Japanese illustrator, Yano Mitsuki and is featured in “Nekomimi Sweet Housemates,” a visual novel developed by Animal Herb which was released on Steam in 2022. Yano Mitsuki is a popular illustrator who has been involved in games, light novels and is also the character designer of the VTuber, Airani Iofifteen.

[url=https://www.makeship.com/petitions/mint-from-nekomimi-sweet-housemates-by-yano-mitsuki]Support the campaign and show your interest here![/url]

[b]About Makeship Pledges[/b]
The petition campaign will run for 10 days. During this time, the campaign must reach 200 pledges in order to go from concept to a fully realized physical product campaign. The $2 pledge acts as a deposit for the full retail product which will be charged to supporters once the actual product launch begins. Should the campaign fail, the $2 pledge will be refunded.

notes.title: NEKO-MIMI SWEET HOUSEMATES Vol. 1 Just Released!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41980347/103d4cf27387f6c68d19223cbacb2ef82ad3c317.png[/img]

NEKO-MIMI SWEET HOUSEMATES Vol. 1 just released on Steam! Enjoy the release in English, Japanese, and Simplified Chinese! We'd love for you to give Animal Herb a warm welcome on Steam. A free demo is available for download if you'd like to try before you buy as well. Thanks for your support!

notes.title: NEKO-MIMI SWEET HOUSEMATES Release Date Announcement!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41980347/13ddd21a5d018cf727c52f2ba81c6abc4091ff36.png[/img]

Oh what exciting news do we have to share with you today! NEKO-MIMI SWEET HOUSEMATES now has a release date! Drumroll... dondondondondon... April 8th! Yes! Look forward to playing with Mint, Lily, and Cacao this Friday. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/41980347/c0a46a2b2654917b0441191b15f32db7f822b1f3.jpg[/img]
I can't wait to meet you, Master! -Mint

Don't forget to download the free demo on Steam while you're here~

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1789650/NEKOMIMI_SWEET_HOUSEMATES_Vol_1/
